name: Big Arm Unit - Flathead Lake State Park

lead.note: Big Arm Unit, Flathead Lake SP (MT) (mt-1): ReserveAmerica tags most campsites and the group site 'Near Water'; FWP describes camping by a long pebble beach on Big Arm Bay; entry lakeview.
lead.prior_evidence: FWP: forest camping under ponderosa on Big Arm Bay w/ mountain-range views across lake; satellite: sites in open ponderosa ~100-150m back from open pebble beach

lead.note: Greenough Lake (MT, USFS) (mt-2): FS 'along the banks of the Main Fork of Rock Creek'; rec.gov tags 7 of 18 sites Riverfront; entry not waterfront.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 45.058,-109.410: Rock Creek crossed by bridge at campground entrance, loops set back uphill in conifer forest; Greenough Lake ~1/4mi walk per rec.gov; no creekside RV pads confirmed

lead.note: Lolo Creek (MT, USFS) (mt-3, weak): FS 'forested and adjacent to Lolo Creek'; entry not waterfront.
lead.prior_evidence: canopy-blind satellite; USFS page 'forested and adjacent to Lolo Creek' but no per-site creekside detail, forested screen - default down

lead.note: Moose Creek Flat (MT, USFS) (mt-3): FS 'sits next to the Gallatin River', fishing dock 'at the river's edge'; rec.gov 'River Access', 'Beach Access'; entry not waterfront.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 45.355,-111.173: meadow loop sits between Hwy 191 and the Gallatin River, separated from the river by a continuous conifer strip that screens the water; RVs in the meadow, none at the bank

lead.note: Many Pines (MT, USFS) (mt-3): FS 'The 23 campsites are located along Belt Creek'; entry not waterfront.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 46.8988,-110.6895: loop set in forest west of US-89; Belt Creek ~30m off with continuous forest between loop and creek, no open apron; no per-site map - default down

lead.note: Lid Creek (MT, USFS) (mt-3): rec.gov 'lies on the Hungry Horse Reservoir', FS 'on the west shore'; entry lakeview.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 48.2880,-113.9105: RV loops on Hungry Horse Reservoir peninsula among a conifer fringe with wide drawdown beach; no legible pad on the open apron, but reservoir on multiple sides supports overlooks; rec.gov gives no per-site flag

lead.note: Langohr (MT, USFS) (mt-3): rec.gov 'Waterfront Sites', 'Creek Access', 'Most campsites are situated in open meadows along the creek'; entry riverview.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 45.535,-111.016: open-meadow loop ~30-40m from Hyalite Creek with willow riparian band buffering the bank; rec.gov 'most sites in open meadows along the creek' - view floor met, willow buffer keeps it off-water

lead.note: Lakeside, Lake Alva (MT, USFS) (mt-3): rec.gov tags all 5 sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront', amenity 'Lake Access'; entry not waterfront.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 47.3060,-113.5757: 3 RV sites sit EAST of Hwy 83 in forest; Lake Alva is west across the highway + treeline; 'lake access' is a walk-across, not frontage
